_doc: Hand-maintained registry of machine-checkable doctrine claims, linted against the CURRENT generated specs by scripts/claims_lint.py (wired into scripts/validate.py --strict). Each entry: id, finding (the audit finding it came from — required), pattern (Python regex, re.M), optional paths (fnmatch globs) / heading (nearest-heading regex), assert {kind, model, field, value}, polarity asserts|denies. See the claims_lint.py docstring for the assertion kinds. Not under specs/ — specs/ is generated.
